verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies an agent-runnable path. gstack ships a /gstack-upgrade skill that detects a global vs vendored install and runs the upgrade from inside an agent session, and a community user describes its install as git-clone-and-copy, which is scriptable. Agents can also write and save their own per-site skills and promote them to global. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive or promptless install command, explicit headless end-to-end install docs for agents, and hands-on confirmation that an agent can install a skill without prompts.
